posts.title: Sharp Shooters win the Etown Metro fall session
posts.body:
The Tuesday Etown Metro session wrapped up on October 27 after 11 weeks, and it came down to the wire. Sharp Shooters finished first with 393 points, just 3 ahead of Comeback Cueists at 390. Off the Rail took third with 378.

Blazing Cue-migos and The Recyclables tied for fourth at 341, followed by Gunners 2.0 (337), Balls in Hand (324), On Cue (314), Traitor Ron (295), Make 'em Pay (274), Beyond Cue (216) and The Billiard Bandits (213).

Among players with at least 6 matches, Justin Geary led the division at 14.67 points per match, followed by Gerry Herron (13.63) and Roy Christofferson (13.50). Makayla Lowery was the top female player at 10.88 points per match.

Tim Bryant ran the table 9 times, five of them in 10-Ball, well clear of Michael Roark's 5. Gerry Herron and Austin Wheatley had 4 snaps apiece. Doug Estes and Austin Wheatley led with 3 shutouts each, Steve Jaggers and Chip Graas each won a rackless match, and Justin Geary picked up 2 three-foul wins.

And on October 20, Roy Christofferson scored 23 points to join the Hall of Hustlers. Congratulations, Roy!

Thanks to every team, and to Apex Billiards, American Legion Post 113 and Hot Shots for hosting. Details on the next Tuesday session are coming soon.

posts.title: Gerry Herron's second Hall of Hustler
posts.photo_alt: Gerry Herron's Hall of Hustlers certificate: 24 points in NAPA 9-Ball on October 12, 2026
posts.body:
With all the NAPA Nationals going on this week APEX Billiards co owner, Gerry Herron sneaks in an impressive 24 pointer and moves into a small club of repeat offenders! Great shooting Gerry.

24 points · NAPA 9-Ball · October 12, 2026

posts.title: Schedules and Team Hub are live
posts.body:
Every active division's schedule is now on the site, week by week, with scores added the morning after each league night.

The new Team Hub gives a team its own PIN-protected page with its next match, full schedule, and links. Team pages are set up on request. Captains, if you'd like one for your team, message us on Signal and we'll get it set up.
